INT. MARA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Mara sits at her desk, surrounded by spreadsheets. Her brother's note is pinned to the wall.

                MARA
        The account number. It's the thread that unravels everything.

She types furiously. The screen reflects in her glasses.

                MARA (CONT'D)
        If I follow this far enough...

INT. POLICE STATION - DAY

Detective Oak reviews case files. His captain enters.

                CAPTAIN
        Drop the Chen case. It's a dead end.

                OAK
        With respect, sir — it's not.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Mara meets Oak for the first time. The empty kitchen mirrors the emptiness of the case.

                OAK
        You're the accountant.

                MARA
        And you're the detective who thinks my brother was murdered.

                OAK
        I don't think. I know.
